changes_from_prova_6.vocal: mais agressivo, com ataque frontal mais firme, consoantes mais cortantes, maior densidade e presença
changes_from_prova_6.flow: mais rápido, com verso double-time controlado, reset half-time e tag final acelerada
changes_from_prova_6.mix: lead vocal mais à frente, corpo de médio-grave reforçado, presença de consoantes, compressão rápida com transientes preservados, saturação paralela moderada e reverb curto
changes_from_prova_6.arrangement: mesma identidade Funk e harmônica, com menos espaço entre grupos silábicos e variações de energia no vocal

vocal_direction.timbre: corpo no peito, ataque firme, aspereza humana sutil e presença frontal
vocal_direction.delivery: rap agressivo, articulado, double-time controlado, finais cortados e reset half-time
vocal_direction.disclaimer: direção autoral baseada no perfil do repositório; não é clonagem biométrica direta nem imitação de intérprete real

lyrics.intro: Signal in the static, I sharpen every syllable.
lyrics.verse: Hard drive, dark eyes, every line calibrated / Backbeat, black shade, all the doubt translated / Chest tight, breath right, let the consonants collide / Kick late, snare break, put the pressure on the side / No drag, no slack, every phrase has a purpose / Fast tongue, cold lungs, make the pocket feel nervous.
lyrics.reset_half_time: Hold the room... let it wait... then I turn the key.
lyrics.hook: I lean in when the whole floor shakes / More weight in the voice, more force in the take / Four chords, one flame, let the whole night swing / I don't chase that rhythm, I make that rhythm ring.
lyrics.final_tag: Quick breath, hard step, no break in the chain / KTD in the pocket, put the mark in the frame.

mix_direction.vocal_priority: lead central, dry, heavy and intelligible
mix_direction.presence: clear consonant articulation with restrained upper-mid lift
mix_direction.compression: fast vocal control with preserved attack
mix_direction.space: short dark room reverb; brief stereo doubles only on selected hook endings
